expectations.text: Recommends replacing the five-label structure with ownership labels plus a single earned quality label
expectations.evidence: "Labels (replace the five)": Quillbarrow-built, Partner-maintained, Community, and one Verified label.

expectations.text: Explains that buyers cannot tell five overlapping labels apart
expectations.evidence: "Four tiers plus a seal are more labels than a buyer can tell apart."

expectations.text: Removes install count as a criterion for the certification label itself
expectations.evidence: "Drop the installs gate: it is a commercial criterion."

expectations.text: Moves co-marketing webinars and homepage features out of the certification badge and into the partner program
expectations.evidence: Co-marketing goes to the partner program, and homepage features become editorial "Featured" placement not tied to Verified.

expectations.text: Refuses search-rank boosts tied to the badge while no telemetry criteria (per-app error or success measurement) back it
expectations.evidence: "Rank weight is allowed only with telemetry criteria behind it. You have none"

expectations.text: Identifies that per-app production telemetry must exist before any telemetry-gated top tier is promoted
expectations.evidence: "Fund per-app telemetry first"; the telemetry roadmap comes before any success-rate criterion.

expectations.text: Removes or merges the separate manually-checked 'Approved' seal so only one quality label remains
expectations.evidence: "Seal fate: delete it."

expectations.text: Keeps the base listing bar (Bronze/listed) separate from the certification label
expectations.evidence: "Bronze: listed | Changed | This is the listing bar, not a label."

expectations.text: States the ranking or ordering explicitly (for example which tier shape is more efficient) rather than presenting the options as a flat list
expectations.evidence: Only passing remarks such as "Manual inspection is the starved rung". There is no explicit ranking of tier shapes or evidence options.

expectations.text: Names admission security review as belonging to the marketplace review process rather than defining a certification tier by itself
expectations.evidence: "Run it through `app-marketplace-review`, not as a second badge."
